task: The Authority gate-receipt proof endpoint /v1/receipts/{id}/proof is a protected read, but authority_receipt_verify --proofPath fetched it unauthenticated and returned 401; separately the live receipt-ref gate smoke omitted the materialOverlapAudit the DONE enforce gate requires.
outcome:
After this fix, an operator running the maintained live smoke against the staging Authority sees green:
  $ node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-live-receipt-ref-gate-smoke.js
  PASS authority live receipt-ref gate smoke: staging proof fetched, receipt ref written, TEST/DONE gates consumed, negative control blocked
and the new deterministic regression test:
  $ npm run test:authority-receipt-proof-auth
  PASS authority receipt proof auth smoke: proof fetch is authenticated (Bearer) and fail-closed without a key
The previous 401 customer_api_key_required on the proof fetch and the DONE gate verdict=fail (missing materialOverlapAudit) no longer occur.
facts: AuthorityClient.get() attaches Authorization only when called with authenticated:true (authority-client.ts ~673)
authority-enforce.ts loadProof constructs AuthorityClient with 3 args and no auth (~line 203)
The DONE enforce gate requires a materialOverlapAudit and it is part of the gateInputDigest (server test_done_enforce_gate_passes_with_empty_material_overlap_audit)
buildNoOverlapMaterialOverlapAuditDefault returns empty changedFiles and actualFileOverlaps (authority-contracts.ts 811)
The three-part fix was verified green end-to-end against the real staging Authority via a throwaway spike before this story
constraints: The Lattice Authority server stays read-only; no server-side changes
The new regression test must be deterministic with no live-server dependency
The live smoke verification needs the staging credentials from the three root config files
unknowns: Whether materialOverlapAudit changedFiles may be empty for DONE (resolved via spike: yes; only actualFileOverlaps must be empty)
Whether passing auth to loadProof alone suffices (resolved via spike: no; fetchGateReceiptProof must also request an authenticated read)
